subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this issue stay as an evidence-gathering vLLM Usage-page bug, be routed to the unknown-pricing contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674, or be routed to the custom OpenAI-compatible streaming-usage decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96463?
rationale: Current main already has the official vLLM streaming-usage path and Usage-page aggregation path, but the report does not show whether the remaining failure is missing token metadata, missing local pricing, custom-provider compatibility, or UI aggregation.

options.title: Request current vLLM evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a raw vLLM stream, transcript entry, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before choosing a code fix.

options.title: Route to unknown-pricing contract
options.body: If the evidence shows token counts are present but cost is blank or missing, treat the remaining product decision as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Route to custom-provider compatibility
options.body: If the config uses a generic custom provider rather than the `vllm` provider, preserve this context on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96463.

recommendation.title: Request current vLLM evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a raw vLLM stream, transcript entry, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before choosing a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The usage-cost and vLLM streaming-usage history points to this area, and the remaining question is a maintainer product/contract decision rather than a narrow local repair.
